## DOMAINS

### Astrobiologie

Groups: 3 · Skills: 12

[astrobiology.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/astrobiology/astrobiology.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Scientific investigation of the possibility, conditions and evidence of life beyond Earth, including chemical origins, habitability and contamination risks. The methods of spacecraft observation are classified with astronomical instrumentation and evidence rather than presented as a separate astrobiological subject.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Explore ce dont la vie au-delà de la Terre pourrait avoir besoin et comment reconnaître des preuves fiables de son existence.

#### Conditions nécessaires à la vie

Skills: 4

[conditionsForLife.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/astrobiology/conditionsForLife/conditionsForLife.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Evaluating environments for life requires explicit biological and geochemical assumptions; familiar Earth conditions are useful evidence, not universal proof.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Réfléchis aux environnements et aux processus chimiques qui pourraient permettre à la vie d’exister.

##### Analogues d’extrêmophiles

[extremophileAnalogues.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/astrobiology/conditionsForLife/skills/extremophileAnalogues.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Interpret how Earth organisms in extreme environments inform hypotheses about extraterrestrial habitats without proving life exists there.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Appuie-toi sur la vie dans les milieux extrêmes terrestres pour étudier d’éventuels habitats extraterrestres.

##### Habitabilité

[habitability.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/astrobiology/conditionsForLife/skills/habitability.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Evaluate energy sources, chemical building blocks, solvent availability and environmental stability as possible prerequisites for known life.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Explore comment l’énergie, la chimie, les liquides et la stabilité peuvent rendre un milieu habitable.

##### Évolution de l’habitabilité dans le temps

[habitabilityThroughTime.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/astrobiology/conditionsForLife/skills/habitabilityThroughTime.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Assess how a world's environmental history may change its potential to support life.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Étudie comment les changements de l’environnement d’un monde influencent sa capacité à accueillir la vie.

##### Chimie prébiotique

[prebioticChemistry.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/astrobiology/conditionsForLife/skills/prebioticChemistry.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Explain plausible nonliving chemical pathways relevant to life's origins while distinguishing hypotheses from established histories.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Découvre comment des réactions chimiques non biologiques auraient pu produire des substances nécessaires à l’origine de la vie.

#### Indices de vie

Skills: 5

[evidenceOfLife.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/astrobiology/evidenceOfLife/evidenceOfLife.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** A proposed sign of life must be weighed against nonbiological processes and the limits of the measuring instrument.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Apprends à distinguer les signes possibles de vie des explications ne faisant pas intervenir le vivant.

##### Faux positifs abiotiques

[abioticFalsePositives.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/astrobiology/evidenceOfLife/skills/abioticFalsePositives.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Identify nonbiological processes capable of producing signals superficially similar to biosignatures.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Découvre comment des processus non biologiques peuvent imiter des signes évoquant la vie.

##### Biosignatures

[biosignatures.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/astrobiology/evidenceOfLife/skills/biosignatures.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Evaluate chemical, morphological or other candidate indicators that might be produced by living systems.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Reconnais les indices chimiques ou physiques susceptibles d’être liés à des organismes vivants.

##### Normes de preuve pour la détection de vie

[lifeDetectionEvidenceStandards.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/astrobiology/evidenceOfLife/skills/lifeDetectionEvidenceStandards.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Distinguish suggestive observations from convergent, independently checked evidence sufficient to support a life claim.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Découvre pourquoi les affirmations sur la vie extraterrestre exigent plusieurs vérifications indépendantes.

##### Protection planétaire

[planetaryProtection.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/astrobiology/evidenceOfLife/skills/planetaryProtection.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Explain why forward and backward biological contamination controls matter for mission science and credible life-detection results.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Comprends pourquoi prévenir la contamination biologique est essentiel à la recherche de vie extraterrestre.

##### Technosignatures

[technosignatures.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/astrobiology/evidenceOfLife/skills/technosignatures.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Interpret possible observable indicators of technology without confusing an unexplained signal with confirmed intelligence.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Réfléchis à ce qu’un signal inhabituel pourrait indiquer sur une technologie, sans le tenir pour une preuve d’intelligence.

#### Milieux de recherche de vie

Skills: 3

[searchEnvironments.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/astrobiology/searchEnvironments/searchEnvironments.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Search strategies differ for nearby worlds whose material can be sampled and distant worlds known mainly through remote measurements.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Compare les méthodes scientifiques de recherche de vie dans différents mondes et environnements.

##### Recherche de vie sur les exoplanètes

[exoplanetLifeSearches.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/astrobiology/searchEnvironments/skills/exoplanetLifeSearches.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Interpret the capabilities and limitations of remote atmospheric and planetary measurements in searches for life.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Découvre ce que les mesures de planètes lointaines peuvent, ou ne peuvent pas, révéler sur une vie possible.

##### Recherche de vie dans le Système solaire

[solarSystemLifeSearches.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/astrobiology/searchEnvironments/skills/solarSystemLifeSearches.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Compare scientific search approaches for places such as Mars and icy moons using expected environmental indicators.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Explore comment les scientifiques recherchent des signes d’habitabilité ou de vie sur Mars et les lunes glacées.

##### Habitats souterrains

[subsurfaceHabitats.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/astrobiology/searchEnvironments/skills/subsurfaceHabitats.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Explain why liquid environments protected under ice or rock can be relevant even when a surface is hostile.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Découvre pourquoi les océans cachés sous la glace ou la roche peuvent être des lieux prometteurs à explorer.

### Instruments et preuves astronomiques

Groups: 6 · Skills: 30

[astronomicalInstrumentsAndEvidence.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/astronomicalInstrumentsAndEvidence/astronomicalInstrumentsAndEvidence.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Astronomy infers properties of remote objects from electromagnetic radiation, gravitational effects, particles and spacecraft observations. This domain covers what an observation can reveal, how instruments and methods constrain the evidence, and how competing interpretations are evaluated, not the engineering construction of observatories and spacecraft.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Découvre comment les astronomes recueillent des indices grâce à la lumière, à la gravitation, aux particules et aux missions spatiales pour étudier des mondes lointains.

#### Spectres astronomiques

Skills: 5

[astronomicalSpectra.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/astronomicalInstrumentsAndEvidence/astronomicalSpectra/astronomicalSpectra.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Light encodes information about temperature, composition and motion through its distribution across wavelength and the signatures imprinted by matter.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Découvre comment décomposer la lumière selon ses longueurs d’onde révèle les propriétés d’objets lointains.

##### Raies spectrales d’absorption

[absorptionSpectralLines.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/astronomicalInstrumentsAndEvidence/astronomicalSpectra/skills/absorptionSpectralLines.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Interpret dark spectral features produced by matter absorbing characteristic wavelengths from background radiation.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Reconnais les raies sombres du spectre comme des indices de matière qui absorbe la lumière.

##### Spectres continus

[continuousSpectra.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/astronomicalInstrumentsAndEvidence/astronomicalSpectra/skills/continuousSpectra.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Infer broad thermal properties from the distribution of emitted light across wavelengths while recognizing idealized blackbody assumptions.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Utilise un spectre continu pour étudier la température d’un objet et la lumière qu’il émet.

##### Décalage Doppler

[dopplerShift.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/astronomicalInstrumentsAndEvidence/astronomicalSpectra/skills/dopplerShift.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Interpret wavelength shifts due to relative radial motion, distinguishing this local effect from cosmological expansion.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Utilise les changements de longueur d’onde pour étudier un mouvement vers l’observateur ou dans la direction opposée.

##### Raies spectrales d’émission

[emissionSpectralLines.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/astronomicalInstrumentsAndEvidence/astronomicalSpectra/skills/emissionSpectralLines.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Interpret discrete bright features produced by matter radiating at characteristic wavelengths.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Reconnais les raies lumineuses du spectre comme des indices sur la matière qui émet de la lumière.

##### Observation multi-longueurs d’onde

[multiwavelengthObservation.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/astronomicalInstrumentsAndEvidence/astronomicalSpectra/skills/multiwavelengthObservation.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Relate observations in different electromagnetic bands to distinct physical components and processes within one object.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Combine des images et des mesures prises dans différentes bandes de lumière pour comprendre un objet céleste.

#### Distances et propriétés physiques

Skills: 6

[distancesAndPhysicalProperties.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/astronomicalInstrumentsAndEvidence/distancesAndPhysicalProperties/distancesAndPhysicalProperties.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Astronomical measurements connect remote observations to inferred size, distance and energy output using explicit models rather than direct contact.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Découvre comment les astronomes estiment des propriétés qu’ils ne peuvent pas mesurer directement.

##### Magnitude absolue

[absoluteMagnitude.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/astronomicalInstrumentsAndEvidence/distancesAndPhysicalProperties/skills/absoluteMagnitude.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Interpret a source's magnitude at a defined reference distance and use it to compare intrinsic brightness.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Compare la luminosité intrinsèque des objets en utilisant la même distance de référence.

##### Magnitude apparente

[apparentMagnitude.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/astronomicalInstrumentsAndEvidence/distancesAndPhysicalProperties/skills/apparentMagnitude.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Interpret a logarithmic brightness scale describing how bright a source appears to an observer.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Comprends l’échelle utilisée pour décrire l’éclat apparent d’un objet céleste.

##### Unités de distance astronomique

[astronomicalDistanceUnits.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/astronomicalInstrumentsAndEvidence/distancesAndPhysicalProperties/skills/astronomicalDistanceUnits.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Interpret astronomical units, light-years and parsecs as units of length, relate their scales and distinguish light-travel distance from travel duration.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Compare les unités astronomiques, les années-lumière et les parsecs comme mesures de distance.

##### Échelle des distances cosmiques

[cosmicDistanceLadder.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/astronomicalInstrumentsAndEvidence/distancesAndPhysicalProperties/skills/cosmicDistanceLadder.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Explain why different distance indicators apply across different ranges and how calibration errors can propagate.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Découvre pourquoi les astronomes emploient différentes méthodes pour mesurer les distances dans l’Univers.

##### Chandelles standards

[standardCandles.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/astronomicalInstrumentsAndEvidence/distancesAndPhysicalProperties/skills/standardCandles.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Explain how calibrated luminosity indicators support distance estimates beyond direct parallax measurements.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Découvre comment des objets dont la luminosité est connue permettent d’estimer les distances.

##### Parallaxe stellaire

[stellarParallax.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/astronomicalInstrumentsAndEvidence/distancesAndPhysicalProperties/skills/stellarParallax.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Infer distances to nearby stars from the apparent displacement caused by changing observing positions.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Utilise le changement apparent de position d’une étoile proche pour estimer sa distance.

#### Preuves et interprétation

Skills: 4

[evidenceAndInterpretation.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/astronomicalInstrumentsAndEvidence/evidenceAndInterpretation/evidenceAndInterpretation.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Astronomical conclusions require comparisons between predictions and measured signals, including attention to uncertainty and alternative explanations.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Apprends à évaluer des conclusions astronomiques à partir des mesures, des incertitudes et d’autres explications possibles.

##### Courbes de lumière astronomiques

[astronomicalLightCurves.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/astronomicalInstrumentsAndEvidence/evidenceAndInterpretation/skills/astronomicalLightCurves.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Interpret changes in brightness over time as evidence for rotation, variability, eclipses or transiting objects.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Lis un graphique de l’éclat en fonction du temps pour trouver des indices sur les changements d’un objet céleste.

##### Mise à l’épreuve de modèles astronomiques

[astronomicalModelTesting.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/astronomicalInstrumentsAndEvidence/evidenceAndInterpretation/skills/astronomicalModelTesting.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Compare competing explanations with observations and revised predictions, including historically important planetary models.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Compare les prédictions de modèles astronomiques aux observations et vois lesquelles résistent à la vérification.

##### Incertitude de mesure

[measurementUncertainty.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/astronomicalInstrumentsAndEvidence/evidenceAndInterpretation/skills/measurementUncertainty.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Evaluate how instrument limits, measurement error and model assumptions affect the confidence of an astronomical inference.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Reconnais comment les erreurs et les hypothèses influencent la confiance accordée aux mesures astronomiques.

##### Effets de sélection observationnelle

[observationalSelectionEffects.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/astronomicalInstrumentsAndEvidence/evidenceAndInterpretation/skills/observationalSelectionEffects.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Identify how detection thresholds and survey methods bias the populations of celestial objects that appear in catalogs.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Découvre pourquoi les télescopes et les relevés du ciel détectent certains objets plus facilement que d’autres.

#### Observations gravitationnelles et de particules

Skills: 4

[gravitationalAndParticleProbes.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/astronomicalInstrumentsAndEvidence/gravitationalAndParticleProbes/gravitationalAndParticleProbes.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Gravitational lensing, gravitational waves and astrophysical particles supply information that differs from ordinary electromagnetic imaging and spectroscopy; a multimessenger inference combines distinct independent signals. Lensing is observed through light affected by gravity and is not itself a non-electromagnetic measurement.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Découvre comment la gravitation et les particules apportent des indices que les images astronomiques ordinaires ne montrent pas.

##### Effet de lentille gravitationnelle

[gravitationalLensing.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/astronomicalInstrumentsAndEvidence/gravitationalAndParticleProbes/skills/gravitationalLensing.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Interpret bending, magnification and distortion of background light by intervening gravity as evidence about mass and source geometry.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Découvre comment la gravitation dévie et amplifie la lumière, révélant des masses autrement invisibles.

##### Astronomie des ondes gravitationnelles

[gravitationalWaveAstronomy.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/astronomicalInstrumentsAndEvidence/gravitationalAndParticleProbes/skills/gravitationalWaveAstronomy.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Interpret gravitational-wave detections as evidence about accelerating compact massive systems and compare the signals with electromagnetic observations.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Découvre ce que les ondes gravitationnelles révèlent sur des systèmes massifs qui évoluent rapidement.

##### Indices issus de l'astronomie multimessager

[multimessengerEvidence.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/astronomicalInstrumentsAndEvidence/gravitationalAndParticleProbes/skills/multimessengerEvidence.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Explain how electromagnetic light, neutrinos, gravitational waves and particles can offer complementary evidence about an astrophysical event.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Combine les observations de lumière, d'ondes gravitationnelles et de particules pour étudier un même événement cosmique.

##### Astronomie des neutrinos

[neutrinoAstronomy.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/astronomicalInstrumentsAndEvidence/gravitationalAndParticleProbes/skills/neutrinoAstronomy.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Explain how astrophysical neutrinos probe energetic processes that electromagnetic observations may not reveal.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Découvre comment les neutrinos révèlent des phénomènes très énergétiques que la lumière ne montre pas entièrement.

#### Observations par sondes spatiales

Skills: 4

[spacecraftObservations.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/astronomicalInstrumentsAndEvidence/spacecraftObservations/spacecraftObservations.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Remote flybys, orbiters, landers and sample-return missions provide different access to remote worlds. These competencies concern scientific evidence, temporal coverage, sampling limits and interpretation; they exclude the engineering design of the vehicles.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Découvre ce que différentes missions spatiales peuvent mesurer sur des mondes lointains.

[flybyMeasurements.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/astronomicalInstrumentsAndEvidence/spacecraftObservations/skills/flybyMeasurements.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Interpret scientific information obtained during a brief spacecraft encounter, including coverage constraints.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Découvre ce qu'un bref survol par une sonde spatiale peut révéler et ce qui peut lui échapper.

##### Atterrisseurs et astromobiles comme sondes scientifiques

[landersAndRoversAsScientificProbes.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/astronomicalInstrumentsAndEvidence/spacecraftObservations/skills/landersAndRoversAsScientificProbes.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Interpret the local environmental evidence obtained by landed missions without treating vehicle design as an astronomy competency.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Découvre ce que les atterrisseurs et les astromobiles peuvent apprendre grâce à des mesures prises sur place.

##### Mesures orbitales

[orbitalMeasurements.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/astronomicalInstrumentsAndEvidence/spacecraftObservations/skills/orbitalMeasurements.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Explain how repeated observations from an orbiting spacecraft support mapping and temporal monitoring.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Comprends comment des observations répétées depuis l'orbite permettent de cartographier des mondes et de suivre leurs changements.

##### Données tirées des échantillons rapportés de l'espace

[sampleReturnEvidence.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/astronomicalInstrumentsAndEvidence/spacecraftObservations/skills/sampleReturnEvidence.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Explain how collected extraterrestrial materials can be analyzed and how contamination or context loss affects conclusions.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Découvre ce que révèlent les échantillons rapportés de l'espace et comment une contamination peut fausser les conclusions.

#### Télescopes et détecteurs

Skills: 7

[telescopesAndDetectors.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/astronomicalInstrumentsAndEvidence/telescopesAndDetectors/telescopesAndDetectors.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Instrumentation alters the detail, wavelengths and measurable signals available to observers; its scientific limitations are as important as its capabilities.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Découvre ce que les télescopes et les détecteurs peuvent révéler et pourquoi leurs mesures ont des limites.

[angularResolution.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/astronomicalInstrumentsAndEvidence/telescopesAndDetectors/skills/angularResolution.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Explain the ability to distinguish nearby sources, including effects of aperture, wavelength and atmospheric seeing.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Explique pourquoi deux objets proches dans le ciel peuvent apparaître séparés ou se confondre dans un télescope.

##### Détecteurs astronomiques

[astronomicalDetectors.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/astronomicalInstrumentsAndEvidence/telescopesAndDetectors/skills/astronomicalDetectors.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Explain how detectors capture light or other signals and why exposure, noise, calibration and sensitivity matter.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Découvre comment les détecteurs astronomiques mesurent de faibles signaux et pourquoi le bruit et l’étalonnage comptent.

##### Interférométrie astronomique

[astronomicalInterferometry.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/astronomicalInstrumentsAndEvidence/telescopesAndDetectors/skills/astronomicalInterferometry.data.ts)

**User-friendly description (fr):** Comprends comment combiner les signaux de télescopes éloignés permet de distinguer des détails plus fins.

##### Ouverture collectrice de lumière

[lightGatheringAperture.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/astronomicalInstrumentsAndEvidence/telescopesAndDetectors/skills/lightGatheringAperture.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Explain how telescope aperture affects collected light and the visibility of faint astronomical sources.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Découvre pourquoi une plus grande ouverture de télescope permet d’observer des objets célestes moins lumineux.

[opticalTelescopeSystems.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/astronomicalInstrumentsAndEvidence/telescopesAndDetectors/skills/opticalTelescopeSystems.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Interpret the scientific roles of refractors, reflectors and optical configurations without designing their mechanical construction.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Compare la façon dont les lunettes astronomiques et les télescopes à miroirs collectent et focalisent la lumière.

[radioAstronomy.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/astronomicalInstrumentsAndEvidence/telescopesAndDetectors/skills/radioAstronomy.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Interpret observations at radio wavelengths, including the kinds of astronomical sources and atmospheric or detector limitations relevant to these measurements.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Découvre ce que les signaux radio révèlent sur l’Univers.

##### Observations depuis l’espace

[spaceBasedObservation.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/astronomicalInstrumentsAndEvidence/telescopesAndDetectors/skills/spaceBasedObservation.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Compare observations above and below Earth's atmosphere in terms of accessible wavelengths and atmospheric interference.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Compare les observations effectuées depuis l’espace avec celles faites à travers l’atmosphère terrestre.

### Mécanique céleste

Groups: 3 · Skills: 15

[celestialMechanics.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/celestialMechanics/celestialMechanics.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** This domain concerns how gravity and angular momentum govern orbital motion, rotation and mutual perturbations across planetary and stellar systems. Geometrical appearances arising from these motions are addressed separately when the observational phenomenon itself is the competency.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Découvrez comment la gravitation et le mouvement façonnent les trajectoires orbitales et la rotation des objets dans l’espace.

#### Interactions dynamiques

Skills: 4

[dynamicalInteractions.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/celestialMechanics/dynamicalInteractions/dynamicalInteractions.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Real celestial systems include many bodies, so resonances, tides and perturbations can alter otherwise idealized orbital motion.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Découvrez comment les marées et d’autres interactions gravitationnelles modifient les mouvements célestes.

##### Perturbations gravitationnelles

[gravitationalPerturbations.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/celestialMechanics/dynamicalInteractions/skills/gravitationalPerturbations.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Interpret departures from a simple two-body orbit caused by additional gravitational influences.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Expliquez comment des influences gravitationnelles supplémentaires modifient une orbite autrement simple.

##### Résonances orbitales

[orbitalResonances.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/celestialMechanics/dynamicalInteractions/skills/orbitalResonances.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Recognize recurring period relationships that can organize or destabilize orbital systems.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Reconnaissez les cas où des rapports périodiques récurrents entre orbites influencent un système.

##### Stabilité orbitale

[orbitalStability.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/celestialMechanics/dynamicalInteractions/skills/orbitalStability.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Evaluate how changing orbital parameters and interactions can affect whether a system remains dynamically stable.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Découvrez ce qui permet à un système orbital de rester stable ou ce qui peut le modifier.

##### Forces de marée

[tidalForces.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/celestialMechanics/dynamicalInteractions/skills/tidalForces.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Explain differences in gravitational pull across an extended body and their consequences for distortion and orbital evolution.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Découvrez comment des attractions gravitationnelles inégales entre différentes parties d’un astre créent les marées.

#### Mouvement gravitationnel

Skills: 6

[gravitationalMotion.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/celestialMechanics/gravitationalMotion/gravitationalMotion.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Gravitational interactions produce trajectories governed by mass, initial conditions and the reference frame in which motion is described.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Découvrez comment la gravitation régit le mouvement des corps célestes.

##### Mouvement barycentrique

[barycentricMotion.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/celestialMechanics/gravitationalMotion/skills/barycentricMotion.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Explain why interacting celestial bodies orbit a shared center of mass rather than one body always remaining stationary.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Comprenez pourquoi deux corps en orbite se déplacent autour d’un centre de masse commun.

##### Première loi de Kepler

[keplersFirstLaw.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/celestialMechanics/gravitationalMotion/skills/keplersFirstLaw.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Apply the elliptical-orbit relation, with the central gravitating body at one focus in the idealized two-body model, to the geometry of bound orbits.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Reconnaissez qu’une orbite idéale peut être elliptique, avec le corps central situé à l’un des foyers.

##### Deuxième loi de Kepler

[keplersSecondLaw.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/celestialMechanics/gravitationalMotion/skills/keplersSecondLaw.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Use the equal-areas-in-equal-times relation to explain variation in orbital speed as an orbiting body changes its distance from the central focus.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Expliquez pourquoi un corps en orbite se déplace plus vite lorsqu’il est proche du corps central.

##### Troisième loi de Kepler

[keplersThirdLaw.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/celestialMechanics/gravitationalMotion/skills/keplersThirdLaw.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Relate the square of orbital period to the cube of semi-major axis with the appropriate gravitational mass dependence and limitations of the two-body model.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Reliez la période orbitale d’un objet à la taille de son orbite et à la masse responsable de la gravitation.

##### Énergie orbitale

[orbitalEnergy.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/celestialMechanics/gravitationalMotion/skills/orbitalEnergy.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Relate gravitational potential and kinetic energy to bound and unbound orbital trajectories.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Découvrez comment l’énergie détermine si un objet reste sur une orbite liée ou peut s’en échapper.

##### Gravitation universelle

[universalGravitation.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/celestialMechanics/gravitationalMotion/skills/universalGravitation.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Apply the dependence of gravitational attraction on interacting masses and separation to astronomical situations.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Utilisez les masses des objets et les distances qui les séparent pour expliquer leur attraction gravitationnelle.

#### Orbites et rotations

Skills: 5

[orbitsAndRotations.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/celestialMechanics/orbitsAndRotations/orbitsAndRotations.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Orbital shapes and body orientations are specified through distinct physical parameters that affect long-term celestial behavior.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Décrivez et comparez les formes, les périodes et les orientations des mouvements célestes.

##### Rotation axiale

[axialRotation.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/celestialMechanics/orbitsAndRotations/skills/axialRotation.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Describe the spin of a world about its axis, including rotation period and direction, independently of the tilt or precession of that axis.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Décrivez la rotation d’un corps céleste autour de son propre axe.

##### Inclinaison de l’axe

[axialTilt.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/celestialMechanics/orbitsAndRotations/skills/axialTilt.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Interpret the angle between a body's spin axis and orbital reference direction and explain its influence on illumination geometry and seasons.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Découvrez comment l’inclinaison de l’axe d’un monde modifie la répartition de la lumière reçue.

##### Éléments orbitaux

[orbitalElements.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/celestialMechanics/orbitsAndRotations/skills/orbitalElements.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Interpret inclination, eccentricity and other orbital descriptors when comparing celestial trajectories.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Interprétez les paramètres qui décrivent la forme et l’orientation d’une orbite.

##### Périodes orbitales

[orbitalPeriods.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/celestialMechanics/orbitsAndRotations/skills/orbitalPeriods.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Interpret the time needed to complete an orbit and compare sidereal and synodic periods, distinguishing orbital revolution from rotation about the body's own axis.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Distinguez le temps nécessaire pour orbiter autour d’un autre corps de celui nécessaire pour tourner sur soi-même.

##### Rotation synchrone

[synchronousRotation.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/celestialMechanics/orbitsAndRotations/skills/synchronousRotation.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Explain how spin–orbit coupling can produce a repeating orientation toward an orbital partner.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Expliquez pourquoi certains corps présentent presque toujours la même face à leur partenaire orbital.

### Objets cosmiques

Groups: 2 · Skills: 7

[cosmicObjects.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/cosmicObjects/cosmicObjects.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** An overview of what kinds of physical objects and extended structures exist beyond Earth and how they are identified and organized. It teaches classification across cosmic scales and distinguishes an object's physical nature from its environment or apparent visual form; detailed physics belongs to the specialized planetary, stellar, galactic and cosmological domains.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Découvrez les différents types d’objets et de structures de l’Univers et la façon dont les astronomes les classent.

#### Familles d’objets

Skills: 4

[objectFamilies.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/cosmicObjects/objectFamilies/objectFamilies.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Classification of astronomical entities requires more than their appearance in a photograph: a point source, a diffuse cloud, a cluster and an extended galaxy may be distinguished by physical evidence and scale.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Apprenez comment les astronomes distinguent les types d’objets grâce à des indices physiques et non à leur seule apparence.

##### Classification des objets célestes

[celestialObjectClassification.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/cosmicObjects/objectFamilies/skills/celestialObjectClassification.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Classify astronomical sources as stellar bodies, planetary bodies, compact remnants, diffuse clouds, star clusters, galaxies or other broad physical types using characteristic evidence rather than appearance alone.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Reconnaissez les grandes catégories d’objets célestes grâce à leurs propriétés physiques.

##### Objets diffus et composites

[diffuseAndCompositeObjects.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/cosmicObjects/objectFamilies/skills/diffuseAndCompositeObjects.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Differentiate diffuse nebulae, gravitationally associated groups and composite galaxies by their constituents, structure and binding rather than surface resemblance.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Distinguez les nuages de gaz, les groupes d’étoiles et les galaxies selon leur composition et leur organisation.

##### Objets et phénomènes

[objectsAndPhenomena.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/cosmicObjects/objectFamilies/skills/objectsAndPhenomena.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Distinguish enduring physical objects and systems from observed events or effects such as eclipses, meteors, flares and transient brightenings, even when both occur in object catalogs.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Distinguez un objet céleste durable d’un événement tel qu’une éclipse ou une éruption.

##### Frontières entre étoiles, objets substellaires et planètes

[stellarSubstellarAndPlanetaryBoundaries.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/cosmicObjects/objectFamilies/skills/stellarSubstellarAndPlanetaryBoundaries.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Compare physically distinct stars, brown dwarfs and planetary-mass bodies using fusion and mass constraints while acknowledging uncertainties near classification boundaries.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Explorez les différences entre étoiles, naines brunes et planètes, y compris là où leurs catégories se recoupent.

#### Organisation et appartenance

Skills: 3

[organizationAndMembership.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/cosmicObjects/organizationAndMembership/organizationAndMembership.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** A body's membership in a system is a different property from its type; the same class of object can be gravitationally bound, ejected or found in a sparse galactic environment.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Découvrez comment les objets appartiennent à des systèmes astronomiques plus vastes ou se déplacent indépendamment.

##### Planètes errantes

[freeFloatingPlanets.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/cosmicObjects/organizationAndMembership/skills/freeFloatingPlanets.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Explain planetary-mass objects not gravitationally bound to a host star, including proposed ejection or isolated-formation origins and detection by microlensing or thermal infrared emission; distinguish low illumination from a complete absence of radiation.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Découvrez comment les planètes sans étoile hôte peuvent se former, se déplacer et être détectées.

##### Systèmes liés gravitationnellement

[gravitationallyBoundSystems.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/cosmicObjects/organizationAndMembership/skills/gravitationallyBoundSystems.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Distinguish satellite systems, planetary systems, multiple stars, star clusters, galaxies and galaxy clusters by physical membership and characteristic scales.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Comparez les systèmes planétaires, les amas d’étoiles, les galaxies et d’autres systèmes liés par la gravitation.

##### Appartenance et isolement des objets

[objectMembershipAndIsolation.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/cosmicObjects/organizationAndMembership/skills/objectMembershipAndIsolation.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Determine whether an astronomical object is a member of a larger bound system or is apparently isolated, and explain why gravitational context does not by itself determine intrinsic object type.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Déterminez si un objet appartient à un système plus vaste sans confondre cette appartenance avec sa nature.

### Cosmologie

Groups: 5 · Skills: 17

[cosmology.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/cosmology/cosmology.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Cosmology tests models for the Universe's large-scale composition, history and expansion using observations with known horizons and uncertainties. Unresolved questions must remain distinguishable from established evidence.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Étudie l'expansion, l'histoire et la structure à grande échelle de l'Univers grâce aux observations astronomiques.

#### Composantes cosmiques et limites

Skills: 3

[cosmicComponentsAndConstraints.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/cosmology/cosmicComponentsAndConstraints/cosmicComponentsAndConstraints.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Gravitational and expansion measurements constrain otherwise unseen components, while cosmological parameters and theoretical uncertainties limit the interpretations that can be supported by available evidence.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Découvre comment les mesures cosmiques révèlent des composantes et des questions encore mal expliquées.

##### Preuves de l'énergie sombre

[darkEnergyEvidence.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/cosmology/cosmicComponentsAndConstraints/skills/darkEnergyEvidence.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Explain why observations of accelerated expansion motivate a dark-energy component or changes to gravitational models.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Examine les indices montrant que l'expansion de l'Univers accélère.

##### Preuves de la matière noire

[darkMatterEvidence.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/cosmology/cosmicComponentsAndConstraints/skills/darkMatterEvidence.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Interpret dynamical, lensing and cosmological evidence for unseen gravitating mass while recognizing remaining theoretical alternatives.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Découvre pourquoi les astronomes déduisent l'existence de matière invisible grâce à la gravitation.

##### Limites des connaissances cosmologiques

[limitsOfCosmologicalKnowledge.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/cosmology/cosmicComponentsAndConstraints/skills/limitsOfCosmologicalKnowledge.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Distinguish empirical constraints from open problems concerning early conditions, dark components and the global extent of the Universe.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Distingue ce que les observations établissent sur l'Univers des grandes questions encore ouvertes.

#### Expansion cosmique

Skills: 4

[cosmicExpansion.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/cosmology/cosmicExpansion/cosmicExpansion.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Large-scale redshift patterns support an evolving cosmic geometry, not an ordinary explosion into pre-existing empty space.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Découvre ce que les observations révèlent sur l'expansion de l'Univers.

##### Modèles cosmologiques

[cosmologicalModels.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/cosmology/cosmicExpansion/skills/cosmologicalModels.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Compare the predictions and assumptions of simplified expanding-Universe models against observations.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Compare les modèles de l'expansion cosmique, leurs hypothèses et leurs prédictions.

##### Décalage vers le rouge cosmologique

[cosmologicalRedshift.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/cosmology/cosmicExpansion/skills/cosmologicalRedshift.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Explain wavelength stretching associated with the expansion of space, distinguishing it from local Doppler motion.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Comprends comment l'expansion de l'espace étire les longueurs d'onde de la lumière en voyage.

##### Expansion et systèmes liés

[expansionVersusBoundSystems.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/cosmology/cosmicExpansion/skills/expansionVersusBoundSystems.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Explain why the expansion of the Universe does not automatically enlarge gravitationally bound local systems.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Comprends pourquoi l'expansion de l'espace n'écarte pas simplement les planètes, les étoiles ou les galaxies.

##### Relation de Hubble–Lemaître

[hubbleLemaitreRelation.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/cosmology/cosmicExpansion/skills/hubbleLemaitreRelation.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Relate galaxy recession measurements and distance to empirical evidence for expansion within its domain of applicability.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Relie les distances mesurées des galaxies et leurs décalages vers le rouge aux preuves de l'expansion cosmique.

#### Échelles cosmiques

Skills: 4

[cosmicScales.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/cosmology/cosmicScales/cosmicScales.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Distances and times become linked by the finite speed of light, which limits how much of the Universe can be observed.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Explore les distances immenses et les durées en jeu dans l'observation du cosmos.

##### Mesures des distances cosmiques

[cosmicDistanceMeasures.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/cosmology/cosmicScales/skills/cosmicDistanceMeasures.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Distinguish common cosmological distance concepts when relating observed brightness, redshift and scale.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Compare les différentes façons de définir et mesurer les distances en cosmologie.

##### Horizons cosmiques

[cosmicHorizons.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/cosmology/cosmicScales/skills/cosmicHorizons.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Interpret limits on observable or causally connected regions without treating them as physical walls.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Explore les limites de la portée des signaux qui nous parviennent ou influencent d'autres régions.

##### Temps de regard en arrière

[lookbackTime.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/cosmology/cosmicScales/skills/lookbackTime.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Explain why distant observations show objects at earlier cosmic epochs.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Découvre pourquoi regarder plus loin dans l'espace revient aussi à regarder dans le passé.

##### Univers observable

[observableUniverse.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/cosmology/cosmicScales/skills/observableUniverse.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Distinguish the observable region set by signal travel and cosmic history from claims about the entire Universe.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Comprends pourquoi l'Univers observable ne représente pas nécessairement tout l'Univers.

#### Structure et évolution cosmiques

Skills: 2

[cosmicStructureAndEvolution.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/cosmology/cosmicStructureAndEvolution/cosmicStructureAndEvolution.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Density perturbations, gravity and cosmic expansion shape the cosmic web over time. This branch focuses on spatial organization and dynamical evolution, as distinct from the initial hot state or the physical nature of the Universe's dark components.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Étudie comment la gravité organise la matière en grandes structures au fil de l'histoire cosmique.

##### Formation des structures cosmiques

[cosmicStructureFormation.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/cosmology/cosmicStructureAndEvolution/skills/cosmicStructureFormation.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Explain how initially small matter-density differences grow into galaxies and large-scale structure.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Découvre comment de minuscules différences initiales de densité de matière sont devenues des structures cosmiques.

##### Toile cosmique

[cosmicWeb.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/cosmology/cosmicStructureAndEvolution/skills/cosmicWeb.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Describe how filaments, clusters and voids trace the large-scale distribution of matter.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Explore le vaste réseau de filaments de galaxies, d'amas et de régions vides.

#### Modèles et preuves de l'Univers primordial

Skills: 4

[earlyUniverseModelsAndEvidence.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/cosmology/earlyUniverseModelsAndEvidence/earlyUniverseModelsAndEvidence.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** The early hot and dense Universe is reconstructed from relic radiation, primordial abundances and theoretical models whose predictions and evidence have different degrees of support.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Explore les indices utilisés pour reconstituer l'Univers primitif et chaud.

##### Inflation cosmique

[cosmicInflation.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/cosmology/earlyUniverseModelsAndEvidence/skills/cosmicInflation.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Explain the hypothesized early accelerated-expansion phase, distinguish its predicted consequences from direct observation and evaluate what existing cosmic evidence can and cannot establish.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Explore l'idée d'inflation cosmique en distinguant les prédictions des preuves confirmées.

##### Fond diffus cosmologique

[cosmicMicrowaveBackground.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/cosmology/earlyUniverseModelsAndEvidence/skills/cosmicMicrowaveBackground.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Interpret relic microwave radiation and its spatial variations as evidence about the early Universe.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Étudie le faible rayonnement micro-onde laissé par l'Univers primordial.

##### Modèle du Big Bang chaud

[hotBigBangModel.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/cosmology/earlyUniverseModelsAndEvidence/skills/hotBigBangModel.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Explain the evidence-supported early evolution of the observable Universe without claiming that the model fully explains its ultimate origin.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Découvre ce que le modèle du Big Bang chaud explique et ce qu'il ne démontre pas.

##### Nucléosynthèse primordiale

[primordialNucleosynthesis.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/cosmology/earlyUniverseModelsAndEvidence/skills/primordialNucleosynthesis.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Explain the predicted formation of light nuclei and why their observed abundances test early-Universe models.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Découvre comment les modèles de l'Univers primordial prédisent l'abondance des éléments légers.

### La Terre, la Lune et le Soleil

Groups: 4 · Skills: 14

[earthMoonAndSun.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/earthMoonAndSun/earthMoonAndSun.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Here the distinctive geometry of Earth's viewpoint, rotation and revolution produces observable cycles. The scientific emphasis is on explaining familiar sky events from physical arrangements rather than on general geography or atmospheric meteorology.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Comprenez comment les mouvements et les positions de la Terre, de la Lune et du Soleil créent des cycles familiers dans le ciel.

#### Interactions Terre–Lune

Skills: 3

[earthMoonInteractions.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/earthMoonAndSun/earthMoonInteractions/earthMoonInteractions.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** The Earth–Moon system is a long-term dynamical pair whose interactions create measurable effects on Earth and its satellite.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Découvrez comment la Lune et la Terre exercent une influence mutuelle par la gravitation.

##### Orbite lunaire et mois

[lunarOrbitAndMonth.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/earthMoonAndSun/earthMoonInteractions/skills/lunarOrbitAndMonth.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Distinguish the Moon's orbital cycle from the phase cycle by considering Earth's simultaneous revolution around the Sun.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Comparez la révolution de la Lune autour de la Terre avec son cycle répétitif de phases.

##### Évolution des marées Terre–Lune

[lunarTidalEvolution.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/earthMoonAndSun/earthMoonInteractions/skills/lunarTidalEvolution.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Explain how tidal dissipation affects Earth's rotation and the Moon's orbital distance over long timescales.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Découvrez comment les interactions de marée modifient lentement la rotation de la Terre et l'orbite de la Lune.

##### Marées océaniques

[oceanTides.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/earthMoonAndSun/earthMoonInteractions/skills/oceanTides.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Explain the dominant lunar and solar gravitational contributions to periodic changes in sea level, distinguishing ideal equilibrium tides from local coastal conditions.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Comprenez comment la Lune et le Soleil contribuent à produire les marées océaniques.

#### Éclipses et alignements

Skills: 3

[eclipsesAndAlignments.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/earthMoonAndSun/eclipsesAndAlignments/eclipsesAndAlignments.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Occultation and shadow phenomena depend on an observer's line of sight and the relative positions and apparent sizes of bodies.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Découvrez comment les éclipses dépendent de l'alignement des astres et de leurs ombres.

##### Saisons des éclipses

[eclipseSeasons.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/earthMoonAndSun/eclipsesAndAlignments/skills/eclipseSeasons.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Explain why solar and lunar eclipses are not observed at every new or full Moon, using orbital inclination and alignment.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Découvrez pourquoi chaque nouvelle lune ou pleine lune ne provoque pas une éclipse.

##### Éclipses lunaires

[lunarEclipses.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/earthMoonAndSun/eclipsesAndAlignments/skills/lunarEclipses.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Explain the conditions and stages of a lunar eclipse as the Moon encounters Earth's shadow.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Comprenez comment la Terre projette son ombre sur la Lune lors d'une éclipse lunaire.

##### Éclipses solaires

[solarEclipses.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/earthMoonAndSun/eclipsesAndAlignments/skills/solarEclipses.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Explain the conditions, shadow regions and different observational appearances of a solar eclipse.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Expliquez quand une éclipse solaire se produit et pourquoi son apparence varie selon le lieu d'observation.

#### Apparence de la Lune

Skills: 4

[lunarAppearance.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/earthMoonAndSun/lunarAppearance/lunarAppearance.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** The Moon's changing appearance follows its illumination and orbital viewing geometry, not changes to its intrinsic light production.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Découvrez comment le mouvement de la Lune et la lumière du Soleil modifient ce que nous observons depuis la Terre.

##### Libration lunaire

[lunarLibration.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/earthMoonAndSun/lunarAppearance/skills/lunarLibration.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Explain why changing perspective exposes slightly different portions of the lunar surface over time.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Découvrez pourquoi des parties légèrement différentes de la surface lunaire deviennent visibles au fil du temps.

##### Mouvement de la Lune

[lunarMotion.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/earthMoonAndSun/lunarAppearance/skills/lunarMotion.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Trace the Moon's changing position against background stars across successive nights.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Suivez les changements de position de la Lune par rapport aux étoiles d'une nuit à l'autre.

##### Phases de la Lune

[lunarPhases.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/earthMoonAndSun/lunarAppearance/skills/lunarPhases.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Explain the repeating illuminated shapes visible from Earth through the Sun–Moon–observer geometry.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Expliquez pourquoi la partie éclairée de la Lune semble changer de forme au fil de ses phases.

##### Hémisphères proche et éloigné de la Lune

[nearAndFarLunarHemispheres.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/earthMoonAndSun/lunarAppearance/skills/nearAndFarLunarHemispheres.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Distinguish the hemisphere generally facing Earth from the opposite hemisphere without equating the far side with permanent darkness.
